instruction: You are the compliance manager for Northstar Controls. Resolve FACTORYBENCH-090 (Open corrective maintenance after a safety interlock bypass). Correlate the incident record, asset, and lockout approval before creating urgent corrective work. The case is an isolated snapshot as of 2026-01-12; correlate immutable IDs and effective revisions rather than matching names alone. After the documented Oracle operation, add the Oracle result as a Drive comment; then create the requested email draft without sending it. Return exactly: compliance_case, contained_record, evidence_reference.
